notes: UI-free PlayniteSettingsService over the p4-004 migration envelope: typed read/update with documented v10 defaults, envelope validation through SettingsMigration.ExportV10, explicit MigrateFromV10Async, unknown/legacy preservation, Changed subscription, and sibling-temp atomic writes with an unchanged file on failure. Raw v10 configs are refused until explicitly migrated; corrupt or unsupported files never overwrite. Load also range-checks every documented key against its CLR type (int, long, double, bool, string, enum), so an out-of-range or malformed value is an explicit InvalidValue instead of an OverflowException on a typed read; BOM input and strict System.Text.Json failures are handled without a raw parser escape.
